scope: native-library-only dependency comparison; baseline driver and AOT service held constant
host: shared Apple M3 Ultra / macOS arm64 / 32 logical CPUs / 512 GiB RAM
quantiles: sorted index floor((n-1)*p), per process, then median across three runs
warmup: 512 HTTP2 and 512 HTTP3 actual requests per process; excluded from measured medians
caveats: Shared host; unrelated work may introduce noise.
No audit builds/tests/companion inference overlap these passes.
Process-tree time/RSS includes startup and helpers; not isolated allocator profiling.
Setup pilot 00-baseline omitted from comparison before collecting six timed passes.
An unrelated VM consumed approximately ten CPU cores during the later passes; baseline multiplex throughput dropped by roughly 70%.
Median serial HTTP2 throughput fell 4.9%; this is not accepted as a cleared no-regression result.
status: Performance confirmation pending due shared-host contention and the serial HTTP2 decrease

lower_load_confirmation_attempt.reason: Stopped between processes while waiting for unrelated inference load to fall; no processes or measured samples were interrupted. Two processes are insufficient to resolve the initial comparison.
lower_load_confirmation_attempt.cpu_sampling: Category totals from ps before/after processes, not continuous monitoring; 100 percent represents one logical CPU.

canonical_production_gates.caveat: Absolute checked-in production gates; not a repeated before/after speed comparison. No audit builds/tests/inference overlap measured workloads.

large_frame_and_file_gates.caveat: Absolute checked-in production gates, not repeated before/after comparisons. Throughput follows the canonical dominant-direction metric, unlike the initial HTTP request-plus-response total payload metric.
